layout.observations: One left-aligned block with three horizontal lines: 서로, 다른, 속도. Whole words wrapped; no fixed line breaks were requested.

text.observations: The six Hangul syllables read clearly in native, usage720 and thumbnail320 views.

style.checked_requirement: Constructed cut-paper graphic, unequal meshing wheels, broad swept sectors, compact firm Hangul adjacent to mesh.

observations.observation: Blue large lower-left wheel and red small upper-right wheel have matte cut-paper surfaces, raised plain hubs and inset pale sectors. Shallow shadows lie consistently down-right.

issues: Teeth near the shared contact do not visibly enter matching valleys.

observations.observation: Two large unequal toothed bodies remain the main graphic even when imagining the title hidden.
Unequal gear bodies establish connected parts at different scales; the small pale sector spans substantially more angle than the large pale sector.

issues: Actual transmission is weakened by tip-to-tip contact.

observations.observation: Unwarped bold syllables show open internal spaces and stable horizontal strokes; whole-word line breaks preserve the required word boundaries.

observations.location: title beside the orange wheel and above blue wheel
observations.observation: The title occupies the shared left wedge rather than a separate header; its lower edge is close to the blue tooth silhouette.
The upper-right blue tooth and lower-left red tooth meet near their tips; surrounding tooth valleys remain largely empty rather than visibly interleaving.

issues: Repair the tooth phasing and center separation to show a working alternating mesh.

observations.location: both wheel rims and pale sectors
observations.observation: Cut edges are distinct, pale sector sheets have fine short shadows and the matte paper has visible fiber. Stronger wheel shadows make the relief somewhat deeper than the restrained-cut-paper intention.
The large blue wheel dominates the lower-left, smaller orange wheel and dark title balance the upper area; the complete mesh region is inside the frame.
The small-wheel sweep has a larger angle, but symmetric blunt ends do not clearly indicate opposite rotational senses.

residuals.limit: Tooth-tip contact lacks clear tooth-into-valley engagement, limiting mechanical credibility.

residuals.location: pale sectors on both wheel faces
residuals.limit: Angular extent differs visibly; rotation direction is not independently legible from the blunt symmetric ends.
